nodes.title: Open the prepared cart
nodes.description: Use test customer U-01 with cart C-01. Verify the staging build before starting.
nodes.steps: Sign in with the approved test account; open the prepared one-item cart.
nodes.expected_result: The SKU, quantity and total match fixture C-01.

nodes.title: Submit the order once
nodes.description: Use the approved test checkout path; no real settlement is in scope.
nodes.steps: Enter address fixture A-01 and submit once. Record the order identifier.
nodes.expected_result: Exactly one confirmation appears with an order ID.

nodes.title: Verify order history
nodes.description: Compare the persisted record with the confirmation.
nodes.steps: Open order history and locate the confirmed order.
nodes.expected_result: The same ID, item, quantity and total appear; no duplicate exists.

texts.content: Preconditions: approved staging build; disposable customer/cart/address. Cleanup: cancel the test order using the agreed process. No real payment settlement.
